thread:
maria-ops: heads-up: onboarding new paid tenant "sidecar" in ap-southeast-11. we need accelerator capacity + network headroom. Request: p5.48xlarge x6, g5.48xlarge x10, p4d.24xlarge x2. ENI +200, EIP pool +1000, NATGW +2. Who can own?

sam-infra: @maria-ops i can take. are the p5s for prod serving or pre-prod? which AZ spread? also need vCPU counts for the quota forms.

maria-ops: prod serving. will do canary: 2 p5 + 2 g5 first, then scale to 6/10. spread across AZ a/b/c in the region.

lee-eng: suggestion: consider moving some batch/training to p4d to consolidate and save. if p4d x2 stays we can shift non-latency jobs.

raj-cloud: ran quick checks on account 912345678901: accelerator quotas show 0 vCPUs for p5 by default in ap-southeast-11. instance-type offering shows p5.p48x available in region. network defaults: ENIs 256, EIPs 5, NATGW 1. i'll file requests but need strong justification + cost estimate + AZ placement.

maria-ops: justification: customer-facing LLM inference with 99.9% latency SLO. customer signs committed monthly reserved slot for p5s.

sam-infra: filing checklist (will include in ticket):
- AWS Account: 912345678901
- Region: ap-southeast-11
- Instances: p5.48xlarge x6 (a/b/c), g5.48xlarge x10 (spread), p4d.24xlarge x2
- ENI bump: +200
- EIP bump: +1000 (consider pushing back to hybrid)
- NATGW: +2
- Business justification: prod inference capacity for committed customer

lee-eng: quick on-demand cost rough estimates to include in ticket:
- p5.48xlarge ~ $60/hr *6 -> ~ $259k/month
- g5.48xlarge ~ $40/hr *10 -> ~ $288k/month
- p4d.24xlarge ~ $40/hr *2 -> ~ $57k/month
we'll swap for RI/commit pricing but include these numbers.

maria-ops: tagging @finance for approval. also current VPC pilot is /24 per AZ, probably needs resizing.

raj-cloud: subnet note: /24 won't be sufficient. recommend /22 per AZ to handle instances + ENIs + autoscaling. AWS may push back on 1000 EIPs; propose hybrid: 300 EIPs + 4 NATGW + NAT egress pool, prefer private endpoints and load balancer for public traffic. i'll put this in net ticket.

sam-infra: agreed. i'll open two requests: (1) service-quotas accelerator entitlement (p5/p4/p4d) (2) networking increases (ENI/EIP/NATGW + VPC subnet change). will include subnet CIDR change request to VPC team.

quota-bot: Ticket created: SQ-87231 (accelerator entitlement) -> https://aws.amazon.com/support/cases/SQ-87231
quota-bot: Ticket created: NET-66412 (ENI/EIP/NATGW/VPC) -> https://internal.redwood/infra/tickets/NET-66412 :thumbsup:

maria-ops: canary schedule: provision 2x p5 + 2x g5 next Wed 08:00 UTC, 48h smoke. if green, scale to full in 1 week. please add me to tickets.

lee-eng: ops tips: use spot for non-prod canary nodes, reserved for prod serving. consider placement groups for low-latency MP workloads. also enable enhanced networking (ENA) and EFA if cross-instance comms needed.

raj-cloud: added subnet /22 per AZ to NET-66412 and ENI consumption math (instances * ENIs + autoscale buffer + LB/EFS attachments). also call out KMS/HSM binding and key policies for HSM-protected keys prior to go-live.

sam-infra: filed both tickets with cost & AZ breakdown. AWS ETA: accelerator entitlement 3-10 business days; network increases variable. i'll loop TAM and ping for expedited review.

maria-ops: thanks. need a fallback plan if capacity delayed: @sam-infra can you sketch?

sam-infra: draft fallback: route tenant traffic to hosted-redwood-api with reduced model and rate-limits, automatic failover via routing policy with health checks, and notify SRE/Customer success. attach to NET-66412.

lee-eng: LGTM. keep thread active until AWS responds.

maria-ops: ack, thanks everyone :rocket:
